en.title: Preliminary Screening Note: Possible Land Change in Wetland Buffer Area (DB-0001)
en.summary: Satellite remote sensing detected significant surface disturbance across approximately 1.42 hectares within the Wetland Buffer Area (WBA) starting around 2025-04-15. Indicators include a +5.9 dB increase in radar backscatter and a -0.35 drop in NDWI, suggesting potential pond filling, surface drying, or ground consolidation that may conflict with statutory planning intentions.
evidence: Affected Area: 1.42 hectares identified under anomaly ID DB-0001.
Radar backscatter delta: +5.9 dB indicating substantial surface roughening, structural development, or fill materials.
NDWI delta: -0.35 indicating a marked decline in open water surface or wetland moisture levels.
First detected: 2025-04-15 within the designated Wetland Buffer Area (WBA).

statutory_basis.claim: TPB PG-No. 12C, paragraph 6.4: Intention of the WBA is to protect the ecological integrity of fish ponds and wetland within the WCA and prevent development causing negative off-site disturbance.
TPB PG-No. 12C, paragraph 6.5: Development or redevelopment requiring planning permission from the Board within the WBA requires submission of an ecological impact assessment.
TPB PG-No. 12C, paragraph 6.6: Applications for new open storage or container back-up uses within the WBA would normally not be allowed due to adverse disturbance to birds.

en.recommended_action: Conduct an urgent on-site inspection to verify physical ground conditions and check Planning Department records for valid planning permissions or ecological impact assessments associated with site DB-0001.
en.limitations: Findings are based solely on automated satellite radar and optical index alerts; ground-truthing and cadastral title verification are necessary before statutory enforcement steps can be confirmed.

zh_hant.title: 初步篩選紀要：濕地緩衝區疑似土地變化（DB-0001）
zh_hant.summary: 衛星遙感監測於2025年4月15日首次偵測到濕地緩衝區（WBA）內約1.42公頃的地面異動。雷達後向散射增加5.9 dB，且歸一化水體指數（NDWI）下降0.35，顯示可能存在填塘、地表乾燥或填土工程，或與法定規劃意向不符。
evidence: 受影響面積：於異常代號 DB-0001 處偵測到約 1.42 公頃。
雷達後向散射變量：+5.9 dB，顯示表面粗糙度顯著增加、存在填土或人為構築跡象。
NDWI 變量：-0.35，顯示水體面積或濕地濕度顯著降低。
首次偵測日期：2025年4月15日，位於濕地緩衝區（WBA）範圍內。

statutory_basis.claim: 城市規劃委員會指引第12C號第6.4段：濕地緩衝區的規劃意向是保護濕地保育區內魚塘和濕地的生態完整性，並防止對魚塘生態價值產生負面影響的發展。
城市規劃委員會指引第12C號第6.5段：在濕地緩衝區內進行須向城規會申請許可的發展或重建，須提交生態影響評估。
城市規劃委員會指引第12C號第6.6段：鑒於露天貯物或貨櫃後勤用途對鳥類造成干擾，在濕地緩衝區內的新申請通常不會獲得批准。

zh_hant.recommended_action: 安排實地視察以確認現場地貌變動，並核查規劃署檔案以確認該地段是否已獲取有效規劃許可或已提交生態影響評估報告。
zh_hant.limitations: 本摘要僅依據自動化衛星雷達及光學指數監測數據生成，採取正式法定執法行動前必須進行實地核證及查核地段業權。
